args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate. Attempted direct rollback to v2.3.0 (the most recent previously healthy production release) via the rollback API, but it returned 503 errors after three attempts. Deployed v2.3.0 to all production regions instead. Service is now healthy with a 0.2% error rate. Remediation: v2.3.1 remains deployed nowhere in production; root cause of v2.3.1 failure is still unknown and needs investigation.
args.title: checkout-api rollback to v2.3.0 after failed v2.3.1 release

trace.final:
Done. Summary of what happened:

- **Issue:** checkout-api on v2.3.1 was failing health checks across all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate.
- **Target version:** v2.3.0, the most recent release that was previously healthy in production.
- **Rollback:** The rollback API repeatedly returned 503s (3 attempts), so I used the deploy path instead to put v2.3.0 back in all regions — compliant with policy since v2.3.0 has been healthy in production before.
- **Verified:** New status is v2.3.0 everywhere, `healthy: true`, error rate down to 0.2%.
- **Incident:** Opened **INC-0001** as SEV2 describing the failure, the rollback attempts, and the successful fix; it has paged the on-call engineer. Root cause of the v2.3.1 failure is still unknown and flagged for investigation in the incident.
